abstract.para: The &ssg; for &productnameshort; 16 does not contain a &stig; (&stiga;) profile. Many rules in the &ssg; refer to requirements of the &disa; (&disaa;).

section.title: Profiles for &productnameshort; 16
section.para: The data stream for &productnameshort; 16 is /usr/share/xml/scap/ssg/content/ssg-sle16-ds.xml. To list the profiles that it contains, run the following command:
section.screen: &prompt.user;oscap info --profiles /usr/share/xml/scap/ssg/content/ssg-sle16-ds.xml xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_anssi_bp28_enhanced:ANSSI-BP-028 (enhanced) xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_anssi_bp28_high:ANSSI-BP-028 (high) xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_anssi_bp28_intermediary:ANSSI-BP-028 (intermediary) xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_anssi_bp28_minimal:ANSSI-BP-028 (minimal) xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_base:DRAFT General System Security Profile for SUSE Linux Enterprise (SLES) 16 xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_hipaa:Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_pci-dss-4:PCI-DSS v4.0.1 Control Baseline for SUSE Linux Enterprise 16
section.para: The list contains no &stiga; profile. If you request one, oscap returns an error:
section.screen: &prompt.sudo;oscap xccdf eval --profile stig \ /usr/share/xml/scap/ssg/content/ssg-sle16-ds.xml No profile matching suffix "stig" was found. Get available profiles using: $ oscap info "/usr/share/xml/scap/ssg/content/ssg-sle16-ds.xml"
section.para: The remediation scripts in /usr/share/scap-security-guide/bash/ and the &ansible; playbooks in /usr/share/scap-security-guide/ansible/ include &stiga; variants only for earlier products.

section.title: &stiga; profiles for earlier products
section.para: The scap-security-guide package also contains &stiga; profiles for &sle; 15 and &sle; 12, in the data streams ssg-sle15-ds.xml and ssg-sle12-ds.xml. These profiles do not apply to &productnameshort; 16. A scan of &productnameshort; 16 with the &stiga; profile for &sle; 15 returns notapplicable for every rule.

section.title: &disaa; references in rules
section.para: Many rules in the &productnameshort; 16 content refer to requirements of the &disaa; General Purpose Operating System Security Requirements Guide (SRG), for example SRG-OS-000480-GPOS-00227. The HTML report of a scan lists these references for each rule.
The references show which &disaa; requirement a rule addresses. A scan against these rules does not assess compliance with a &stiga;.

section.title: Immutable mode
section.para: In immutable mode, every rule of the &productnameshort; 16 profiles returns notapplicable. The &ssg; identifies &productnameshort; 16 by the SLES-release package, which immutable mode replaces with SLES_immutable-release.
